### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/competitive-calls-cs/48165818
Total Call Budget: €340,169
Maximum Grant Amount: €20,000 per support request; in exceptional cases (e.g. relocation of a large team), grants can be up to €40,000. Such requests must be reasoned in detail and must be approved by the EFCSN Governance Body in addition to the standard selection procedure outlined below.
Cifras anteriores en notación española (la fuente usa la coma inglesa como separador de miles): 20.000 €, 40.000 €, 340.169 €
